questions.question: Which is the largest species of penguin?
questions.hint: Emperor penguins are the tallest and heaviest penguin species, living in Antarctica.

questions.question: Which flower is famous for turning toward the Sun?
questions.hint: Young sunflowers follow the Sun across the sky in a movement called heliotropism.

questions.question: Which movie won the first Academy Award for Best Animated Feature?
questions.hint: Shrek won the inaugural Best Animated Feature Oscar in 2002.

questions.question: What is the name of Iron Man's artificial intelligence assistant in the early Marvel films?
questions.hint: J.A.R.V.I.S. assists Tony Stark with managing his suits, home, and technology.

questions.question: Which color is commonly used for pedestrian crossing signs in many countries?
questions.hint: Blue traffic signs often provide information or indicate pedestrian crossings, though designs vary by country.

questions.question: What does 'www' in a website address stand for?
questions.hint: The World Wide Web is a system of interconnected webpages accessed over the Internet.

questions.question: Which famous document begins with the words 'We the People'?
questions.hint: The U.S. Constitution opens with the famous phrase 'We the People.'

questions.question: Which civilization built Machu Picchu?
questions.hint: Machu Picchu was built by the Inca civilization in the Andes Mountains of Peru.

questions.question: Which country hosts the Wimbledon Championships?
questions.hint: Wimbledon is held each year in London, England, and is the oldest tennis tournament.

questions.question: In Formula 1, what is the black-and-white checkered flag used for?
questions.hint: The checkered flag signals that the race has ended.

questions.question: Which country has the greatest number of neighboring countries?
questions.hint: China shares land borders with 14 countries, tied for the highest in the world.

questions.question: Which sea separates Europe from Africa?
questions.hint: The Mediterranean Sea lies between southern Europe and northern Africa.

questions.question: Which particle has a negative electric charge?
questions.hint: Electrons carry a negative charge and orbit the nucleus of an atom.

questions.question: Which planet takes the longest time to orbit the Sun?
questions.hint: Neptune takes about 165 Earth years to complete one orbit around the Sun.

questions.question: Which country is famous for the traditional dance called the Flamenco?
questions.hint: Flamenco combines singing, guitar playing, and expressive dance, originating in southern Spain.

questions.question: Which country is known for celebrating the Cherry Blossom Festival?
questions.hint: Cherry blossom season, known as Sakura, is one of Japan's most celebrated annual events.

questions.question: Which animal can regenerate lost arms?
questions.hint: Many starfish can regrow lost arms, and some can even regenerate an entire body.

questions.question: Which country is home to Mount Fuji?
questions.hint: Mount Fuji is Japan's highest mountain and an iconic national symbol.

questions.question: Which scientist is known for discovering penicillin?
questions.hint: Alexander Fleming discovered penicillin in 1928, leading to the first widely used antibiotic.

questions.question: Which famous ship carried Charles Darwin on his scientific voyage?
questions.hint: Darwin's observations aboard HMS Beagle helped inspire his theory of evolution.
